title: FrankenGit workflow construct registry
description: Per-construct status for the GitHub-Actions subset. ADR-0008 D12: a measured registry, not a blanket compatibility claim. A construct marked unsupported or ambiguous is REFUSED at validation, never ignored.

constructs.reason: selects an execution image, which is an isolation decision AGENTS.md 9 puts outside workflow YAML
turns a failed job into a passing one, which is gate self-weakening expressed as configuration
names a deployment target with its own protection rules; the rules, not the name, are the authority
expression truthiness has several context-dependent coercions; refusing beats guessing which one a reader meant
accepted as a scalar or a sequence of job identifiers; unknown names and cycles are refused
output values come from expressions, and expressions are not evaluated by this lowering
grants capability from YAML; AGENTS.md 9 says text may not widen capabilities
a single runner label, as a plain scalar
starts side-car containers, which is the same isolation decision as job.container
a sequence of steps, in source order, which is execution order
matrix expansion multiplies jobs, and the expansion order and identifier derivation need their own bead
a budget belongs to the effect broker's reservation, not to a YAML field the runner may ignore
same expression semantics as job.if
a display label; it carries no meaning for execution
the command line, preserved verbatim; the lowering does not interpret shell syntax
runs a third-party action, which is correctness logic living in YAML rather than in a repository-owned command (AGENTS.md 12)
only meaningful as arguments to step.uses, which is refused
a concurrency group cancels in-flight runs, and cancellation semantics are request-drain-finalize rather than a YAML string
workflow-level environment leaks into every step invisibly; the subset requires a step to state what it needs
a mapping of job identifier to job; identifiers must be unique
a plain scalar display name
accepted as a scalar or a sequence of trigger names, normalized to a sorted deduplicated list
a secret reference in YAML is a capability grant; AGENTS.md 9 keeps that out of untrusted text
an alias lets one node be reached twice, so a bounded node count cannot bound the expanded document
an anchor only exists to be aliased, and aliases are refused
the only mapping form in the subset; entries keep source order
the folding and chomping indicators have several spellings with subtly different results, so accepting them would mean accepting an ambiguity
the only sequence form in the subset; items keep source order
discarded after scanning; it cannot carry meaning, so dropping it is not a silent drop of content
a workflow is one document; --- and ... would make the file's meaning depend on which document a reader picked
accepted with backslash escapes resolved, so a quoted and an equivalent plain scalar lower to the same bytes
flow style admits nesting without indentation, which defeats the depth limit the scanner relies on
same as flow mappings: depth without indentation
<< depends on aliases, and it makes a key's value depend on a node declared elsewhere
trailing whitespace is stripped; no type inference is performed, so 'on' stays the string "on"
accepted with '' resolved to a single quote, the only escape the form has
YAML forbids tabs in indentation, and accepting them would make depth depend on a renderer's tab width
an explicit tag selects a type resolver, and the subset performs no type resolution at all
